resources.string: Not from CREA? Use your Google account: you get a private folder in your Drive and the public catalog. AI and natural voices are only for CREA accounts.

Your private “CREA Reader” folder in your Google Drive: only you see it. Books you upload from the app with “Upload to Drive” and the ones you add from your Drive follow you to any device where you connect this account.

Already have books in your Drive? Tap “Add books from Drive” and pick the EPUB or PDF files you want, even in other folders: they are read where they are, without copying them. Books you add to your Drive later are picked the same way.
%1$s is a CREA account. Connect it with “Connect CREA account”.
%1$s is not a CREA account (@creanicaragua.org). Connect it with “Use another Google account”.
You have no books yet. On the Drive screen tap “Add books from Drive” to pick the ones you already have, or in My library open a book and tap “Upload to Drive”.
